description: Electrolyte concept library for concept-grounded mutation and scoring. Each concept defines a SMARTS pattern that identifies a structural motif common in battery electrolytes.

concepts.name: cyclic_carbonate
concepts.label: Cyclic Carbonate
concepts.description: Five-membered cyclic carbonate ring (e.g. ethylene carbonate, propylene carbonate). Core SEI-forming motif.

concepts.name: fluorinated_ether
concepts.label: Fluorinated Ether
concepts.description: Trifluoromethyl or perfluoroalkyl group. Drives LiF-rich SEI formation and suppresses Al corrosion.

concepts.name: borate_ester
concepts.label: Borate Ester
concepts.description: Tris(fluoroalkyl/borato)borate or similar boron-based anion fragment. HF-scavenging additive.

concepts.name: sulfone
concepts.label: Sulfone
concepts.description: Sulfonyl group. Contributes to mechanical SEI toughness and acts as an HF scavenger.

concepts.name: carbonate
concepts.label: Carbonate
concepts.description: Carbonate functional group (linear or cyclic). Primary salt-dissociation and SEI-forming motif.

concepts.name: nitrile
concepts.label: Nitrile
concepts.description: Cyano group. High-dielectric contributor and Li+ solvation enhancer.

concepts.name: sultone
concepts.label: Sultone
concepts.description: Five-membered cyclic sulfonate ester. HF-scavenging and cross-linking SEI former.

concepts.name: phosphate_ester
concepts.label: Phosphate Ester
concepts.description: Organophosphate with at least two alkoxy groups. High dielectric constant and Li+ solvation.

concepts.name: glyme_chain
concepts.label: Glyme Chain
concepts.description: Linear ether chain (e.g. DME, G2). Primary Li+ solvation via oxygen lone pairs.

concepts.name: imidazolium_salt
concepts.label: Imidazolium Salt
concepts.description: Imidazolium-based cation or salt fragment. High ionic conductivity component for ionic liquids.
